entries.title: Hosea 14:1
segments: ¶O Israel, return to the LORD your God, For you have stumbled because of your iniquity;

entries.title: Hosea 14:2
segments: Take words with you, And return to the LORD. Say to Him, "Take away all iniquity; Receive [us] graciously, For we will offer the sacrifices of our lips.

entries.title: Hosea 14:3
segments: Assyria shall not save us, We will not ride on horses, Nor will we say anymore to the work of our hands, '[You are] our gods.' For in You the fatherless finds mercy."

entries.title: Hosea 14:4
segments: ¶"I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely, For My anger has turned away from him.

entries.title: Hosea 14:5
segments: I will be like the dew to Israel; He shall grow like the lily, And lengthen his roots like Lebanon.

entries.title: Hosea 14:6
segments: His branches shall spread; His beauty shall be like an olive tree, And his fragrance like Lebanon.

entries.title: Hosea 14:7
segments: Those who dwell under his shadow shall return; They shall be revived [like] grain, And grow like a vine. Their scent [shall be] like the wine of Lebanon.

entries.title: Hosea 14:8
segments: ¶"Ephraim [shall say], 'What have I to do anymore with idols?' I have heard and observed him. I [am] like a green cypress tree; Your fruit is found in Me."

entries.title: Hosea 14:9
segments: Who [is] wise? Let him understand these things. [Who is] prudent? Let him know them. For the ways of the LORD [are] right; The righteous walk in them, But transgressors stumble in them.
